title: Malum Spirit Data for Variants and Ventures
description: Get Malum spirits from Variants and Ventures mobs
body:
This is a datapack that specifies what spirits Variants and Ventures mobs drop when killed by a Malum Scythe. For instance, the Gelid will drop 1 Wicked spirit and 1 Aqueous spirit. This creates futher integration and immersion for your modpack!

![Gelid and Spirits](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7605ff419522cfbb46ed241d41a16b78af31878a.png)

Generated with my Malum Spirit Data Python script.
